title: Agent OS Task
description: A unit of work tracked across the 5-stage pipeline.

requirements.description: Functional and non-functional requirements captured in Stage 1

requirements_format.description: Format Stage 1 used for functional requirements (config preferences.requirements_format at that time). Missing = req.

user_stories.description: Functional requirements as user stories, only when requirements_format = user-stories. Non-functional requirements and constraints stay in requirements.

items.description: One user story: As a <role> I want <capability> so that <benefit>.

priority.description: must = blocking, should = important, could = nice to have.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria, as Given/When/Then or as a checklist.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the requirements-analyst made instead of asking (Stage 1).

out_of_scope.description: What is explicitly out of scope (Stage 1).

open_questions.description: Clarifying questions the requirements-analyst returned in Stage 1 (QUESTIONS block), with their answers. resolution = null means still unresolved.

id.description: Question ID, e.g. Q-1. Unique within the task across question rounds.

question.description: The question, as the analyst wrote it.

why.description: What changes in the requirements depending on the answer.

options.description: The answers the analyst proposed; the first one is its proposed default.

resolution.description: The answer, verbatim, or null while unresolved.

resolved_by.description: human = the user answered; approver = the approver answered (unattended mode only); default = the user explicitly delegated the answer and the analyst's proposed default was applied; null = unresolved.

resolved_at.description: When it was answered (ISO 8601), or null.

git_baseline.description: Uncommitted changes that existed when the task was created, per repo (state-management skill, Recording the git baseline). Post-QA commands use it to exclude pre-existing work: a path still dirty with the same blob is not the task's change. Keys are repo paths relative to the workspace root ('.' for the root). Excludes .agent-os and .codegraph.

head.description: HEAD commit when the task was created, or null when the repo had no commits.

dirty.description: Modified, added, renamed, deleted or untracked files at that moment.

path.description: Path relative to the repo root.

blob.description: git hash-object of the file content at that moment, or null when the file was deleted.

external.description: The tracker issue linked to this task (tracker-sync skill). Missing: no tracker issue.

key.description: Issue key, e.g. VR-123 or REACH-12. Also used in branch names (feature/VR-123-...).

id.description: Tracker internal ID (Jira issue id, Plane work item UUID).

origin.description: pulled = existing issue the task started from; created = agent-os created it.

status.description: Last status agent-os read or set.

existing_subtasks.description: Sub-tasks the pulled issue already had, as reference for the planner.

subtasks.description: Sub-tasks agent-os created, by subtask ID: { "SUB-01": { key, id } }.

pending_writes.description: Gated writes (create, comment) waiting for the user's approval, e.g. queued during an unattended run.

sync_log.description: Every write agent-os made to the tracker, in order. Shown in stage summaries and the final report.

sync_errors.description: Tracker operations that failed or were skipped. /agent-os:tracker sync retries them. They never block the pipeline.

commits.description: Local commits made for this task (written by a post-QA command such as a commit-per-repo user command). Used for the tracker comment.

repo.description: Repository path relative to the workspace root ('.' for single).

subject.description: First line of the commit message.

approver_decisions.description: Every decision the approver took instead of a human (autonomous and unattended modes), in order. Shown in the final 'Approver decisions' report and in /agent-os:review.

kind.description: gate = approved a gate; question = answered a clarifying question; scope-change = decided a planner scope change; revision = re-ran the producing agent with its findings; qa-retry = re-ran development with QA issues; continue-unresolved = advanced after max_revisions with only major/minor left; blocked = stopped on a blocker.

decision.description: What was decided, in one line (e.g. 'APPROVE', 'Q-2: soft delete', 'ORIGINAL_SCOPE').

ref.description: Where the details are in this task file, e.g. 'stages.planning.review (round 2)', 'open_questions Q-2', 'stages.qa.issues'.

plan.description: Plan-level data from Stage 2 (subtasks are in subtasks).

complexity.description: Overall complexity assessed by the planner.

external_dependencies.description: Things outside the codebase the plan needs (APIs, credentials, migrations), with their status.

scope_change.description: Work beyond the approved requirements the planner flagged, or null.

requirements.description: Requirement and story IDs this subtask fulfills (REQ-NNN, US-NNN or US-NNN-ACn).

items.description: Requirement, story or acceptance criterion ID.

decisions.description: IDs of architecture decisions linked to this task (e.g. DEC-001)

files_modified.description: List of file paths modified during development

result.description: e.g. 'In Progress', 'created VR-130', or the error / skip reason (never a token).

id.description: Finding ID prefixed with its review round, e.g. R2-F-01. Unique within the stage across rounds.

severity.description: blocker and major lead to REQUEST_CHANGES; minor alone does not.

target.description: What it refers to: a REQ/US/SUB/DEC/Q ID or a section name.

proposed_change.description: The concrete change the approver proposes.

review.description: One approver review of a stage.

round.description: Review round of this stage, starting at 1. Prefixes the finding IDs.

approved_by.description: Who approved the stage's gate. approver = autonomous or unattended mode (design only in unattended). null for stages without a gate.

review.description: Latest approver review of this stage (discovery, planning; design only in unattended mode).

review_history.description: Earlier approver reviews of this stage, oldest first. A review moves here when a new round replaces it, so cited finding IDs stay resolvable.

auto_revisions.description: Revision runs started without a human: approver REQUEST_CHANGES, and in unattended mode QA REQUEST_CHANGES (counted on qa). Compared with config.approver.max_revisions. Human change requests are not counted here.

unresolved_findings.description: Unattended mode only: IDs of major/minor approver findings (R<n>-F-NN) or QA issues (M-/m-NNN) left open when max_revisions was reached.

issues.description: qa only: issues of the latest QA report, so development revision runs can read them.

id.description: Issue ID from the QA report (C-001 critical, M-001 major, m-001 minor).

location.description: file:line, or the requirement / criterion ID.

change_requests.description: Changes a human requested at this stage's gate, in order. They never count against max_revisions.

id.description: Change request ID within the stage, e.g. CR-1.

text.description: The requested changes, as the user wrote them.

cited_findings.description: Copies of the approver findings the text cites, taken when the request was recorded, so later review rounds cannot change what they refer to.

output_summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of what this stage produced

extension_warnings.description: Warnings recorded when an agent's EXTENSIONS APPLIED section was missing or did not list every resolved extension path.

items.description: Warning text, e.g. 'backend-developer did not confirm applying: /abs/path/SKILL.md'.
